title: Business to Go
summary: A personal time and project management app connecting Kimai and Taiga with offline access.
content:
I developed Business to Go to bring time tracking and project management into one app while improving my app-development skills.

Modular architecture

The app uses The Composable Architecture (TCA) to structure its features. It connects to Kimai for time management and Taiga for project management.

Working offline

An offline mode stores data locally in a SQLite database, allowing the app to retain information without a continuous network connection.

This description reflects the project documented on my earlier portfolio; it does not imply a current public release.
